summary: createAiChatHandler reads a view context (what the user had open when sending the newest message) from the body field glirastesViewContext and gives it to the model as a data block. On by default; nothing sends the field yet, so an unchanged app sees no change.
howTo: Nothing to do. The browser side follows in a later release. To prepare: viewContext: false turns it off; viewContext: { types, maxEntries, facts: { order: z.object({ status: z.string() }) } } narrows the accepted entity types (by default every type the request's tools declare with outputEntities / inputEntities), the entries per message and the facts kept (only for a type with a schema here). history must be 'none' for now; an invalid option throws when the handler is created. Only the built-in stream handler adds the block; continuations, clarification answers, direct commands and a custom streamHandler get none.
